entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
I need to return something.
I can certainly look into that for you. To pull up your account, could I please have your name?
Alex Sterling.
Thank you, Alex. I see your account. And which product was it?
The cycling shoes.
Okay, the cycling shoes. So I can best assist, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault with the shoe or more of a preference issue?
They give me blisters every time I ride. They're useless.

I'm very sorry to hear that. Getting blisters is definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Just to confirm, have you tried making any adjustments to the cleats or trying different socks?
Yes. I've done everything. I just want my money back.

Completely understandable. You're looking for a refund, and I'll check on that for you right now. Let me see... I show the shoes were delivered to you 63 days ago. Let me just confirm the return eligibility.
Fine.
Thank you for your patience. Okay, I've confirmed your purchase is well within our 90-day return policy. I can absolutely process this return for a full refund for you.
Good. It should be.

I've gone ahead and started that process. You'll receive an email with a prepaid shipping label in the next few minutes. Also, Alex, I see you're a VIP member with us. To apologize for the trouble with the blisters, I've added a $20 credit to your account for a future purchase.
Whatever. Just make sure the label actually shows up.
It will be there shortly. Once we receive the shoes, your refund will be processed. Was there anything else for today?
No.
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, Alex. Have a good day.
